content.text:
The comment edit change now follows the edit-window rule. The code was missing that check, and I've added it.

**Answer to question 1:** A comment may be edited for 30 minutes after it was created. After that the API refuses the edit. Source: `policy-edit-window.md`, with "measured from createdAt" from `code-comment-model.md`.

**Changes**
- `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts`: `updateComment` now selects `createdAt` and throws a 403 when more than 30 minutes have passed since creation. The 30-minute value is a constant, `COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_MS`.
- `app/src/tests/services/article.service.test.ts`: the existing success cases now supply a `createdAt` inside the window. A new case checks that an edit 30 minutes and 1 second after creation returns 403 and does not call `update`.

**Rules applied**

| Rule | Value | Source | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Edit window | 30 minutes after `createdAt` | `policy-edit-window.md` | Implemented. Refuses once more than 30 minutes have passed. |
| Author only, lookup by id and author | Comment must match `authorId`; otherwise 404 | `code-comment-ownership.md` | Already in place |
| Not-found status | 404 | `code-comment-ownership.md` | Already in place |
| Error body shape | `{"errors": {field: [messages]}}`, no wrapper | `policy-error-response.md` | Used for 404, 422 and the new 403 |
| `editedAt` | Nullable, null until the first edit, set on each successful edit | `policy-edited-at-marker.md` | Already in place |
| Migration does not change existing rows | `ADD COLUMN ... TIMESTAMP(3)` with no default leaves existing rows NULL | `policy-edited-at-marker.md` | Checked by reading the SQL |
| Migration folder and naming | `app/src/prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_name/` | `code-migrations.md` | Already in place |
| One-line undo note | Present as the first line of the migration | `policy-release-checklist.md` | Already in place |
| Test location and mocking | `app/src/tests/services`, mocked database | `code-test-layout.md` | Already in place |

**Open items and gaps**
- **403 status and message are my choice.** No rule names a status code for a refused edit, and the spec flags this as a gap. I used 403 and the message "edit window has closed". Please confirm or change both.
- **The spec is wrong about the window.** `specs/feature-1-comment-editing.md` says 15 minutes. The policy note says 30, and I followed the policy. The spec needs correcting. I did not edit it because it is outside `app/`.
- **Two sources disagree on the not-found body.** `code-comment-ownership.md` says an empty body. `policy-error-response.md` requires the errors-key body. I followed the policy, as the spec directs.
- **Not run.** I could not run `npx prisma migrate deploy` against a fresh database, the Prisma client regeneration, or `npx nx test api` in this session. The tests are written to pass if run.
